levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Marks the wrong block, or a block from the wrong part of the day, at one or more of the three checks.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly marks the block matching the actual moment at all three checks.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly marks the block at all three checks and explains, in specific terms, how the activity happening matched the block's label.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Names the block that already happened, or a block out of order, instead of the block coming next.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly names the block that comes immediately after the current one at all three checks.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly names the next block every time and, unprompted, estimates roughly how soon it will start.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Recalls two or fewer of the five block labels in the correct order from memory.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Recalls at least four of the five block labels in the correct order from memory.

lookFors: The learner uses the schedule card's printed order, not a guess about clock time, to answer now-and-next questions.
The reflection response names a specific moment and a specific fact learned from the schedule, not a vague 'it helped.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
